record_title: Paths are the unique expected-range maximizers
limitations: Equality is classified for the expectation inequalities only; the stronger stochastic-domination form of BHM is not addressed. The complete 2016 Wu--Xu--Zhu manuscript was not inspected in full, leaving residual risk from a body-only tree equality observation, though such an observation would not cover the all-connected-bipartite classification or the general gap-transfer inequality. Very recent parallel work is an additional originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
